title: Slovakian Pudding Tostada
description: A Mexican-inspired dessert that combines Slovakian pudding with crunchy tostada shells and silky chocolate.
instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over low heat.
2. Add the Slovakian pudding and stir until smooth.
3. Remove from heat and stir in confectioners' sugar until dissolved.
4. Spoon the pudding mixture onto a plate or serving dish.
5. Sprinkle crushed tostada shells over the top of the pudding.
6. Melt the silky chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl in 10-second increments, stirring between each interval.
7. Drizzle the melted chocolate over the tostada shells.
8. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the chocolate to set.
9. Slice into individual servings and serve chilled.
